name: The cursed form exclusion patch reaches the client again after a relog (#5737, #6394)
contract: The client keeps the server's SMSG_PATCH_SPELL rows only for the world entry that received them, so
every login and relog has to be answered with the patch stream again. The stream is sent from the
collection queue when the client's CMSG_EXTENSION_INITIALIZED (0x561) world-entry notice is handled.
That notice used to be dropped whenever an older notice was still queued, and the once-per-character
guard then stopped the resend, so a relogged client fell back to its own Spell.dbc where Bloodmoon
Blast 500125 and the other Mortal Form abilities carry ExcludeCasterAuraSpell 524861 and the tooltip
line $?a524861[...]Requires Mortal Form|r while every Cursed Form keeps 524861. This scenario asserts
the first world entry streams row 500125 with $?a802877, relogs, sends the world-entry notice again and
asserts that a second row 500125 arrived. Expected before: the row is streamed exactly once, so the
relogged client loses the fix. Expected after: the relog streams it again.

steps.label: Let the first world entry and its patch stream settle
The first session streams the Mortal Form row with the internal marker
Let the second world entry settle
Give the queue a tick to answer the world-entry notice
DISCRIMINATING: the relog is answered with the row again
